import subprocess,time,json
commands=[
 ('fmt',['cargo','fmt','--all','--','--check']),
 ('check',['cargo','check','--workspace','--all-targets','--locked']),
 ('clippy',['cargo','clippy','--workspace','--all-targets','--locked','--','-D','warnings']),
 ('test',['cargo','test','--workspace','--all-targets','--locked']),
 ('doc',['cargo','test','--workspace','--doc','--locked']),
 ('release',['cargo','build','-p','logex-node','--release','--locked']),
]
with open('/tmp/logex-index-checkpoint-final-gates.jsonl','w') as results:
 for name,cmd in commands:
  print('Running',name,flush=True);start=time.monotonic()
  with open('/tmp/logex-index-checkpoint-final-gate-'+name+'.log','w') as log:r=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  result={'gate':name,'returncode':r.returncode,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-start}
  results.write(json.dumps(result)+'\n');results.flush();print(result,flush=True)
  if r.returncode:raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
